faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: A few helpful things to know before getting started with Flowiy.

start.question: How do I get started?
start.answer: Select “Create your account” to sign up. If you already have an account, use “Log in” to open your personal dashboard.

languages.question: Can I use Flowiy in English or Italian?
languages.answer: Yes. Use EN or IT at the bottom of the page to choose your language. Login, sign-up and the dashboard follow your selected language too.

preview.question: Do the previews show real data?
preview.answer: No. The homepage cards are illustrative examples. Budgets, goals, reports and advanced sharing options show the product direction and are not all available in the dashboard yet.
